name: Runner Extras - Standalone Suites (consolidated)
brief: Consolidates 16 previously-standalone runner-extras suites (no declared dependencies, no cross-suite hazard) into one app to cut per-bundle CI overhead. See #1847.
description: Each subfolder is one formerly-independent app.json bundle, kept as-is except for its app.json: allobj-virtual-table, allobjwithcaption-virtual-table, crypto-hash-instream, errormessages-page-setrecords, event-var-outstream, extension-object-metadata, field-virtual-table, media-non-image-content, query-join, report-metadata-virtual-table, report-run-execution, report-run-static-unresolvable, report-saveas-stream, table-metadata-virtual-table, task-scheduler-create-task, virtual-field-caption. Verified before merging: every object id/name is unique across the group, every idRange is disjoint, and the virtual-table suites (AllObj/AllObjWithCaption/Field/Table Metadata/Report Metadata/virtual-field-caption) filter every assertion to their own object ids rather than asserting a global count or an exhaustive list, so sharing one object inventory with the other 15 suites does not change what they prove. install-trigger-seed and install-trigger-text-constant were NOT merged in — see their own app.json comments and issue #1847 for why per-app install-trigger semantics make them stay isolated. xmlport-cluster-hooks-1800 (#1800) proves the NavXmlPort ctor-scaffolding/Run/Export/Import/SetTableView cluster, previously an orphaned JmpHook no-op, now actually fires via Cecil ownership. single-site-orphaned-hooks-1883 (#1883 follow-up to #1800/#1947) proves the 15-type 'single Hook() call site' cluster: 14 regression guards for orphaned JmpHook registrations whose call sites were deleted because BC's real, unpatched body was already correct (or already Cecil-owned by a separate mechanism), plus the one genuine bug in that cluster (NavHttpRequestMessage.get_Target), fixed by adding Cecil ownership. isolated-storage-1883 (#1883 follow-up, the 'ALIsolatedStorage 17-hook' cluster) proves the same pattern for the 17 orphaned ALIsolatedStorage.AL* JmpHook registrations deleted from TenantStoragePatches.cs: BC's real, unpatched bodies delegate entirely to IsolatedStorageRepository/ALSystemEncryption, both already Cecil-rewritten onto the SAME in-memory store/AES envelope, so the 17 JmpHooks were pure duplication, not a faithfulness gap. error-string-hooks-1883 (#1883 follow-up) proves the ALSystemErrorHandling (get_ALGetLastErrorText/Code/CallStack, ALClearLastError) and ALSystemString (ALLowercase, ALUppercase) clusters, both deleted because BC's real, unpatched bodies were already correct (the deleted registrations' 'reaches null NavCurrentThread.Session' rationale was stale — Session is already wired to the skeleton), plus a bonus cleanup of 3 further Hook(...) call sites (NavHttpClient/NavHttpRequestMessage/NavHttpResponseMessageBase get_Target) that were provably redundant (already Cecil-owned in every configuration, not just the default) rather than orphaned.
